summary: Bruker Corporation filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $3.9844 per share on its 6.375% Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock, Series A. The dividend was declared on July 30, 2026, payable September 1, 2026, to shareholders of record on August 15, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration on outstanding preferred stock, not a special situation. There is no M&A activity, tender offer, restructuring, or capital return event beyond the ordinary periodic dividend. The filing contains no deal terms, advisors, premiums, or structural changes. This is a standard current report with no special-situations relevance.
